title: L’Eggs
text: Damn, I couldn't wait for algebra to end. Me neither. I was dying to meet up with my beat buddies! Hell, yeah! Well, what do you guys think? Sure our after-school rap group commenced? Okay, definitely. You know I love to freestyle rap. Blaze, you on the beat? You know it. Let's go. -♪ Waking up, rolling out of bed My mom calls me a sleepyhead -♪ No cigarettes, I do not smoke But if you got weed, I'll have a tote Legs looking smooth while I do my grocery Silky and svelte in my brand-new hosiery! Um, sorry, who are you guys? Yeah, who are you guys? I think she's talking about you two. Us? We're your female teen peers. Yes, fellow students who learn. How old are you? Well, we're nine, like you. How old are you guys? We're 15. Yeah, well, so are we. We're post-puberty, but we can't yet join the military. Did you say nine? You think we're nine. Hey, gang, next order of business. What brand of smoothing pantyhose does the rap team wear? Hey, that's what I was wondering, too, Janie. I mean, I can't get on stage if I'm plagued by worry about unsightly leg veins. Am I right, girlfriends? I completely agree. My pantyhose color is suntan beige. And mine is chicken-tender nude. Well, we don't really wear pantyhose. Yeah, we just have these T-shirts and, like, jeans. Okay, are we an after-school rap team or a talking-about-tights team? Come on, Blaze. Never do my chores and never do a dish. Throw the basketball, and it goes swish! Praying for some good legs on my rosary. Complete leg support with Legs brand hosiery! Okay, why do you two keep bringing up hosiery? Okay, we confess. We are sales representatives. For Legs brand hosiery. You see, they come in these big eggs that are not biodegradable. Cool, right? You are voted by your peers as the students who are most likely to wear pantyhose. Yeah. You could put hosiery hot on the market again. No offense, but I don't really even know what hosiery is. Like, is it for grandmas? No. It's for beautiful women who graduated college and are now... and are working a job in hopes that the boss will ask her hand in marriage. Here, we have a simple PowerPoint presentation to explain. Yes. Ew, look at those disgusting legs. I mean, I can see every shadow and curve of the toes. That's not cool. That sucks. I want my legs to look like beige sheer columns for the low, low price of $8 for a pack of 24. Hmm. That is a good deal. It just is. And, well, you aren't the only one that thought that. In the 80s and 90s, everyone wanted hairless, elegant legs with no toenail. Damn, that's cool. Oh, I sure relate to you there, sister. But then came the nightmare whore trends of the early 2000s. Ex-Tina and Miss Spears wore raw legs and toe rings. They didn't know that they were missing out on this. My favorite legs are the legs made with Legs Memory Yarn. I love them. Just take a look at these. I'm not gonna lie. Those legs look good. I love how Le Eggs leaves something to the imagination. Yes, that's right, boys. So, what do you say, students? Do you have what it takes to become brand ambassadors for Le Eggs? We want to, but we don't know how. It's easy. All you have to do is this. Please, teens, it's us legs. We're begging you. Thank you.
